relative_lift.question: The lift is the treatment rate minus the control rate. Divide that lift by the control rate. Return that relative lift, not the raw difference by itself.

cases.expect: The lift is relative to control, not the raw difference alone.

ci_low.question: The 95 percent confidence interval for the observed difference has two ends. Return the lower end only: the observed difference minus the margin. Do not return the upper end.

cases.input: An observed difference of 4 with a margin of 1.
cases.expect: The result is the lower end, difference minus margin, not the upper end.
The lower end is below the observed difference.

ci_high.question: The 95 percent confidence interval for the observed difference has two ends. Return the upper end only: the observed difference plus the margin. Do not return the lower end.

cases.input: An observed difference of 4 with a margin of 1.
cases.expect: The result is the upper end, difference plus margin, not the lower end.
The upper end is above the observed difference.
